text:
liz: :rotating_light: Heads up — incident-bot failed to page oncall for the inference-prod latency slo spike. I had to manually page the oncall.
ben: Thanks for flagging. What happened? any errors from notify-bridge or the webhook?
liz: From the logs it looks like incident-bot got stuck in PROCESSING and never emitted the pager webhook. snippet:```ERROR incident-bot: lock_acquire_timeout key=notify:bridge:lease id=abc123```. Also see repeated `403` from pd-api? Not sure which happened first.
ashok: I just checked notify-bridge: it shows many webhook attempts queued but the worker pool is at 0/4. Restarting pod now.
jordan: If the worker pool is 0 that explains the stuck state. Is this the redis lease deadlock we've seen before?
liz: Possibly. The stack traces show lock held for >30s and the job loop never advanced. I invoked `/manual-page @oncall` and got confirmation from ops that pagers hit. Customers impacted: realtime inference requests saw latency alerts for ~4m, ~3 customers with high-volume requests saw degraded throughput.
ops-bot: Automated mitigation attempted: failover to sms-fallback but that path returned `upstream timeout` due to burst. Manual SMS sent by liz succeeded.
ben: Good catch. For mitigation, we should: 1) clear redis lock `redis-cli DEL notify:bridge:lease:abc123` 2) scale notify-bridge to 3 replicas 3) restart incident-bot deployment 4) run smoke page to PagerDuty.
ashok: Doing 1 and 2 now. FYI the root cause seems like a race on lease renewal when the bridge experienced a short GC spike and failed to renew -> deadlock. We'll add a defensive backoff.
liz: I executed the redis DEL and scaled to 3, then restarted incident-bot. After restart, incident-bot processed the backlog and sent pending pages. I ran a test page: `incident-bot test-page --service inference-prod` and PD showed it.
jordan: Please open a follow-up ticket with timeline and playbook updates. Assign to eng-infra and eng-sre. Also schedule a canary for next deploy to ensure lease renewals are observed.
ben: Created ENG-2345 and linked runbook edits. Suggest adding a health-check metric for worker_pool_size and alert if worker_pool_size == 0 for >30s.
liz: Noted. Customer communication: ops already messaged the 3 affected customers with an apology and status. We'll include an RCA after postmortem.
ops-bot: Incident closed by liz at 1759123580. Reaction: :white_check_mark:
